title: guarded PR create stage map
decision: PR create must be treated as a multi-stage orchestration flow instead of one guarded mutation because local branch writes, remote branch publication, live PR publication, and post-create evidence finalization happen at different failure boundaries.

stages.purpose: Resolve manifest defaults, requested ID, source log path, base branch, and preview output locations.
stages.boundary: Must stop before any branch mutation, push, or PR publication when the basic plan inputs are invalid.

stages.purpose: Collect branch-exclusive commits, select exact-ID commits, derive PR title and scope, and render the preview body.
writes: selected and skipped commit rows in the plan
warning_only_conditions: no branch-exclusive commits matched the requested ID prefix
stages.boundary: This stage may emit warnings or a non-planned item, but it must still stop before any local or remote branch mutation.

stages.purpose: Consume one planned item and verify create prerequisites before any branch is materialized.
hard_stop_conditions: plan item not in planned state
local or remote prepared branch already exists
stages.boundary: All environment, metadata, and branch-name checks must fail before any worktree creation or branch mutation begins.

stages.purpose: Fetch the base branch, create an isolated worktree, switch the prepared branch, and materialize selected changes via cherry-pick or snapshot fallback.
reads: source head snapshot when fallback is needed
writes: local cherry-picked commits or one snapshot commit
recoverable_conditions: cherry-pick conflict triggers snapshot fallback with explicit warning
stages.boundary: This is the first local mutation stage; failures here must not silently continue into remote publish or PR create.

stages.purpose: Push the prepared branch to origin so the later PR create call has a remote head reference.
stages.boundary: This is the first irreversible remote git write; guarded policy cannot treat it as equivalent to later PR object publication.

stages.purpose: Rewrite the final create body, append the Development Link block, and call gh pr create with title, body, labels, milestone, project, and draft state.
hard_stop_conditions: created PR URL cannot be parsed
stages.boundary: This is the first GitHub object publication stage; it must stay distinct from branch publication and from post-create evidence handling.

stages.purpose: Remove the temporary worktree, serialize the create result JSON, and print the final result payload.
stages.boundary: This stage happens after PR publication; a local evidence failure here cannot be mistaken for a no-op create path.

guard_boundary_summary: Stages S1-S3 are pre-publication gates and are candidates for strict fail-closed guarded checks.
Stage S4 is a local mutation stage that may need a separate local-only guard boundary.
Stage S5 is remote git publication and should not be collapsed into the same gate as S6.
Stage S6 is the actual live PR object publication boundary.
Stage S7 is post-create evidence finalization and must be modeled as after-the-fact traceability, not as part of the publish decision.
